initial_variants.prompt:
Use case: high-fidelity ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET, the centered version the user prefers. Keep the centered prompt and action group above the lower hand, the SIMPLE smooth hand-table arc, the inset universal hand count at the left below the arc, both replaceable reliefs, the five LARGE real 392:590 hand cards, their exact size/20% overlap/fan layout, and continuous scenery. Do not modify the lower hand silhouette for any UI component. Do not add a full-width horizontal separator. Keep same full-screen 1586:992 landscape composition, original dark teal/old brass visual style. This task changes ONLY the OTHER-PLAYER layout at the top and the physical edge treatment of the LOCAL-PLAYER and LOG panels at middle left/right.
The top other-player panels must sit on ONE convex arch, center raised, ends lower, echoing the curvature and direction of the hand fan below. Their location follows the arch, not a flat row/grid. Do not make a U-shaped valley. Keep their real information: player name, HP and SAN bars/numbers, visible status markings, four upright portrait card BACKS. Do not invent portraits, mana costs, hidden roles, open enemy card faces or new systems. Every portrait card back retains its portrait proportion, no warped cards. Keep top toolbar unobstructed.
The self player panel remains on the middle LEFT, with "你的身份", "寻宝者", "HP 10", "SAN 10", and the same existing role-goal text. The adventure log remains on middle RIGHT with its existing heading and lines. Preserve internal reading space and allow an internal scrollbar. Both these panels must have a COMPLETELY OPAQUE body and a clearly finished closed lower boundary: NO bottom opacity fade, mist dissolve, feathered edge, torn fading texture or transparent gradient. They are separate restrained thin metal/stone panels, not joined by a line through the center and not attached to the hand-table rail. Deck, inspection and discard piles stay in the central open area. Keep ample gap above the centered controls.
Output one complete game screen only, no comparison sheet, no external labels, no arrows, no marketing copy. Keep details crisp and UI readable. Main objective is the arch arrangement and the non-fading side-panel bottoms; preserve all other layout invariants.
SCHEME A: UPRIGHT ARCH + SHALLOW CURVED FOOT.
All OTHER-PLAYER PANELS remain precisely upright, with horizontal readable name text, bars and card rows. Arrange their x/y positions on the arch; do NOT rotate the panel rectangles. The height variation must be visible yet gentle, like an ensemble arching over the playing area.
LOCAL-PLAYER and LOG side panels use thin antique-brass closed frames, restrained clipped top corners, opaque fine-grained dark green stone bodies, and a very SHALLOW rounded convex lower edge (only about 10–12px of downward bow). A fine matching brass trim seals each bottom; a short contact shadow sits underneath. No pointed shield tips, large crests, thick ornament or curtain shape. Their independent curved feet echo the hand curve subtly without becoming another table or horizontal divider. Position these side panels just below the outer top-player panels, approximately y=335–535.
NORMAL PLAYER COUNT — exactly FOUR OTHER-PLAYER panels at the top (not counting the local self panel). Names left to right: "艾伦", "贝拉", "卡洛斯", "黛安娜". Their four upper-edge center anchors should be approximately (300,115), (625,55), (960,55), (1285,115), with each panel around 290–305px wide and 185–200px high. Preserve a small gap; normal count needs no overlap. The two middle panels are 60px higher than the outer two, making the arch obvious. No panel may intrude into toolbar. Current turn is local, so NONE of the top panels has a current-turn badge. Keep the centered discard instruction "请弃置 1 张手牌" / "已选 0 / 1" and neighboring "确认弃牌" button exactly as the reference. Local hand count remains 5/4.

refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, final UI concept refinement.
The input is the EXACT composition the user has just selected as the correct direction: seven other-player panels in one raised-center arch, second player 贝拉 in front, self and log side panels with clipped lower corners. Preserve this composition and all its proportions. Do NOT introduce a different layout.

Refine only TWO details:
1. REUSABLE TOP FRAME: every one of the seven opponent panels must use ONE IDENTICAL rigid rectangular frame asset, identical size, 90-degree corner geometry, border thickness and small top-edge ornaments. Each whole panel may retain the subtle rigid rotation of the selected fan layout, and its center stays in place along the arch. No perspective skew, trapezoid warping, bent top edges, shearing, individually angled cuts or different panel shapes. All internal HP/SAN bars, text and card backs rotate only together with their whole rectangular panel. Imagine copy-pasting the same frame PNG seven times and rotating/translating each copy without warping. A restrained common shallow curved ornamental cap of at most 8px may sit at the top center of EACH frame; all caps are identical. Preserve seven seat order, readable names/stats, approximately 12–15% overlap, and keep 贝拉 (second from left) fully ABOVE both neighboring panels with "回合中" and gold outline. The active frame has the SAME shape and size, only color/shadow change.

2. FINISH THE SELF/LOG BASES: Keep the selected clipped-corner silhouettes, opaque dark reading areas and their positions. Refine each lower edge into a THIN layered brass sill with two narrow patinated metal bands, crisp bevels, a short band of fine engraved fan-rib detail, and small matching corner fasteners integrated into the existing clipped corners. An unobtrusive center diamond stud can finish the base. Keep total added lower-edge detail only about 16–22px tall. The bases are clear solid architectural closures with a short contact shadow, richer than one plain line, but not heavy pedestals. NO bottom opacity fade, downward-bulging curve, rounded bowl, pointed shield tail, torn edge, claw feet or extension to the main hand-table arc. The bases remain separate; never connect them by a horizontal divider.

Preserve everything else: the CENTERED waiting prompt, all upper UI contents, central piles, simple smooth lower hand arc, inset hand-count badge independent of replaceable props, both sculpted relief images, and the five lower hand cards with exactly their current size, 392:590 portrait ratio, 20% overlap and fan positions. No new gameplay information. Same complete landscape screen. The goal is the user's chosen direction with production-consistent reusable panel geometry and more refined non-fading bottom closures, not another concept.
